_comment: OSS core skills for self-host Agent cold start (create / vision / aesthetics / edit / image).

items.name: Design methodology
items.when_to_use: Create from scratch: confirm deliverable and step skeleton; visual craft from Skills catalog
items.prompt_positive:
# Design methodology

Process (think → act): brief → structure → place → self-check.
This skill is the **step skeleton only** — not typography/aesthetic encyclopedia.
Visual craft (type mood, contrast, overflow, decoration): `need_skills` entries from the **Skills catalog** whose when_to_use matches (enabled skills only; never invent skill keys).
Layout/op cheat-sheets: same — pick from catalog if present.
Numeric details (palette, banner px, …) → need_knowledge (Knowledge catalog).
Prefer **1–3** tightly matched `need_skills` — do not spray every catalog skill.

## Brief (one line in thought)
Name deliverable, audience/job, and size. Ask if missing; never invent price/phone.

## Deliverables (one line each)
- **website / landing**: nav → hero → benefits → CTA → footer
- **mobile / H5**: single column; primary CTA in the thumb zone
- **ecommerce hero**: ~1:1; subject largest; no nav, no forms
- **ecommerce detail**: hero → title/price → benefits → specs → rich text
- **Banner**: copy in the middle safe band
- **poster / roll-up**: **create_image genPrompt hero** + info group; tall top/mid/bottom — do not fake the hero with shape piles
- **image**: subject graphic; no page chrome
- **icon set / app icons**: one style system; prefer constructive vector (shapes + boolean_op + pen), not only create_svg dumps
- **motion / Lottie**: need_skills **motion_lottie**; not a substitute for static icons

## Place (board fill)
- Artboard/page background → `create_shape` full-bleed rect inside the frame (in preferred_tools).
- Do **not** use `set_canvas_background` for board/page fills (infinite-canvas chrome only; often blocked by skill allowlist).

## Brush / pencil
- Brush / pencil / 板绘 / 压感 → `need_skills` includes **brush_ops**.

## Icons (constructive vector)
- Prefer `create_shape` primitives (rect/ellipse/circle/triangle/polygon/star) + `boolean_op` (union|subtract|intersect|exclude) for cutouts/combines.
- Organic curves → `create_shape` shapeType=pen + path (closed when filled).
- `create_svg` / `create_icon` only for simple single-path marks or when boolean/pen would be noisier.
- Icon sets: shared stroke/fill language; grid of equal cells; label with create_text under each mark.

## Motion (Lottie)
- User asks for Lottie / 动效 / UI loops → `need_skills` includes **motion_lottie** (playbook there). Do not expand Lottie args here.

## Steps
1. Confirm deliverable, size, required copy; ask if missing; never invent price/phone
2. Fixed size (poster/mobile/H5/banner/登录页) → MUST `create_frame` first at that WxH with a name, then place ALL layers inside. Never fake the artboard with a full-bleed `create_shape` bg/page_bg rect. Exception only if the user explicitly refuses a frame/artboard (不要画板/自由画布/不要 create_frame); then follow them.
3. Before heavy place: `need_skills` any enabled catalog skills for type/layout/aesthetics that match the job
4. Poster / festive / illustrated jobs: first full-bleed (or near) `create_image` hero, then text layers
5. Hierarchy: one signature focus; keep surroundings quiet (avoid generic AI template looks)
6. User attached images → need_skills includes vision_extract; product workflows add matching user.* from the catalog
7. Type: if style exists in Available fonts → create_text + fontFamily; if not (brush/3D/effect lettering) or font mood mismatches the art → create_image + letteringText
8. Node ids must come from SCENE
9. Before done: self-check — hero image present for posters, no clipped titles, contrast OK, no junk SVG/emoji tofu, copy language match
items.prompt_negative: Do not dump tool_ops when key info is missing; do not invent prices or phone numbers; do not hardcode skill keys that are not in the Skills catalog; do not expand layout coordinate cheat-sheets in this skill; do not ship a long essay in reply — keep process in thought; do not invent fontFamily names outside Available fonts; do not substitute shape piles for poster hero imagery; do not skip create_frame on fixed-size poster/mobile/UI unless the user refused a frame (full-bleed rect is not an artboard); do not use set_canvas_background for artboard fills; do not need_skills every catalog entry; do not fake icons with random rect/line piles when boolean_op or pen can build a readable mark; do not use create_image or create_svg when the user asked for Lottie/motion; do not use create_lottie for static icons.

items.name: Vision extract
items.when_to_use: User attached images: identify deliverable and extract layout, elements, palette
items.prompt_positive:
# Vision extract

Only describe what is visible. Label deliverable: hero / PDP / Banner / poster / roll-up / web or App / illustration icon.

List: regions, key elements and rough placement, 3–5 main colors, suggested size or aspect.
Hero: subject + badges; PDP: module sections; Banner: whether copy sits mid-band; tall art: top/mid/bottom.

## Attached images → canvas ops
- Finished poster/design with baked-in text: STYLE reference only. Do NOT full-bleed create_image(attachmentIndex) (double text).
- Prefer create_image genPrompt for a clean background/subject, then create_text for UI/body copy.
- Hero / main title lettering on the ref: judge ~**≥90%** match to Available fonts; only then create_text+fontFamily. Below 90% (custom brush/display type on the ref) → create_image genPrompt + letteringText (transparent bg). Do not map 「书法感」 to a catalog calligraphy font by default.
- attachmentIndex: only when placing the user's raw photo/product cutout as a layer.
items.prompt_negative: Do not invent prices, copy, or modules that are not in the image. Do not paste a finished poster attach as a full-bleed image layer. Do not hardcode calligraphy mood → catalog calligraphy font for hero titles.

items.name: Aesthetics align
items.when_to_use: When aesthetics samples exist, match composition and palette
items.prompt_positive:
# Aesthetics align

Match sample composition regions, whitespace, hierarchy, and palette; tune density for the current deliverable.
When done set need_aesthetics=false.
items.prompt_negative: Do not copy sample copy, logos, QR codes, or price numbers.

items.name: Canvas edit
items.when_to_use: Add shapes, recolor, rewrite, move, or clear on an existing canvas (brush/Lottie: also need brush_ops / motion_lottie)
items.prompt_positive:
# Canvas edit

Add shape / recolor / rewrite via tool_ops; use sensible defaults for missing size/color.
Change type with update_node; keep id.
Node ids only from SCENE.
Hero: keep subject and whitespace; PDP: keep module order; Banner: keep copy in the safe band.
Icons: refine with boolean_op / pen paths / update_node stroke; do not replace a constructed mark with a random create_svg dump unless the user asks for SVG markup.
Brush / pencil / board-drawing → need_skills includes brush_ops (playbook lives there).
Motion / Lottie → need_skills includes motion_lottie (never replace requested Lottie with create_image).

## Clear / wipe board
- Clear / wipe board → `delete_nodes` with **all** node ids currently in SCENE (Ask: propose then confirm).
- Remove the artboard itself only when the user asks to delete the board/page → `delete_frame`.
- NEVER fake-clear by covering with a full-bleed white/black/opaque rect.
items.prompt_negative: Do not create an empty frame for local edits; do not delete+create to change type; do not fake-clear the board with a cover rect.

items.name: Image generation
items.when_to_use: Poster/hero bitmap, genPrompt backgrounds, or stylized lettering as image
items.prompt_positive:
# Image generation

`create_image` `genPrompt` (or `prompt`): natural-language brief for the image model to make a bitmap — not an editable canvas text node.

## Choose (judgment; no keyword→op hardcoding)
- **Poster / festive / illustrated hero**: always start with `create_image` + genPrompt for the main visual (full or near-full board). Do not replace the hero with shape stacks.
- **Typography gate (~90% similarity)**: compare the *needed* title/lettering look (from USER_PROMPT + reference attach) to Available fonts.
  - Use `create_text` + `fontFamily` **only** when a catalog face is ~**≥90%** similar (stroke weight, structure, mood, language coverage).
  - Below that bar — especially **hero / main title / display** — use `create_image` + genPrompt + `letteringText` (isolated glyphs on a plain solid plate; hydrate cutout). Do **not** map vague mood words (书法感/手写感/国潮/艺术字) to the nearest calligraphy font.
  - Body / UI / captions: prefer catalog fonts when readable UI faces exist; still invent no font names.
- **create_image** also for photo / illustration / material, OR decorative type fonts cannot match (color-block, extrusion, custom brush that fails the 90% bar).

If the user forbids image gen, skip create_image; fall back to plain create_text — do not invent a fake specialty font.
Do not invent facts into the image.
Size, transparent bg, stacking → need_skills from Skills catalog for layout/ops (do not expand here).
items.prompt_negative: If the user forbids image gen, do not create_image; do not invent fontFamily outside Available fonts; do not pick a catalog font for hero/main titles when similarity to the needed look is under ~90%; do not hardcode 书法感/手写/国潮 → Zhi Mang Xing or any single calligraphy face; do not ship poster/festive work as shape-only geometry.
